title: Base guarded trader (Vercel AI SDK)
summary: Reads Base market data (block, gas, Chainlink ETH/USD) and hands the Sato Kit's tools to a Vercel AI SDK generateText loop, which stops for a person's approval before any prepare that would sign and before execute. Every intent is quoted, prepared, simulated and checked by a policy pre-flight that names the rule, limit and observed value of every refusal. Fixture mode uses the AI SDK's mock model from ai/test: no model API, no key, no network. It signs only on a local fork with a throwaway key or on Base Sepolia with a managed wallet, never on mainnet.

tests.description: The platform runs the fixture command over the shipped recordings (no network, no key, no model API) and checks out/report.json against schemas/output.json: exit 0, the over-cap intent refused with its rule, limit and observed value, and the execute call stopped at the AI SDK's tool-approval request.
The template's own tests. Recorded, never the verdict.
Nightly in satohubai/sato-agent-templates: an anvil fork of Base at block 51800000 with recorded quotes; exact reads, an approve simulation and pre-flight outcomes. Never broadcasts.

provenance.notes: Same goal as base-guarded-trader/plain-ts, hosted by the Vercel AI SDK through @satohub/kit/ai-sdk. Deterministic over fixtures with the AI SDK's mock model driven by a script. Live model, fork and testnet modes are opt-in and never run in the platform's offline test phase.
